**[[2026 Iran war]]
***[[2025–2026 Iran–United States negotiations]]
****[[2026 Iran war ceasefire]]

***[[2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis]]
****[[United States Secretary of the Treasury|U.S. treasury secretary]] [[Scott Bessent]] says that [[Oman]] will not participate in imposing tolls on ships and vessels transiting the [[Strait of Hormuz]] after previously threatening to impose sanctions against them earlier in the day if it were to join Iran in doing so. ***[[Kuwait in the 2026 Iran war]]
****The [[Kuwait]]i [[Kuwait Armed Forces|military]] says that they have activated [[air defense]]s to intercept a missile along with drones. [https://apnews.com/article/iran-us-war-oil-may-28-2026-8f5ed2813ba63df7ae9ccbe991688d29 (AP)]
****The [[Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps]] says that it targeted [[List of United States Army installations in Kuwait|an American base]] in [[Kuwait]] in retaliation for the [[May 2026 United States strikes on Iran|recent U.S. strikes]] near [[Bandar Abbas]] including yesterday's. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/us-israel-iran-war/irans-islamic-revolutionary-guard-corps-says-it-targeted-us-airbase-in-kuwait/3950093 (AA)]

***[[2026 Israel–Lebanon ceasefire]]
****At least 19 people, including two children, are killed from [[Israel]]i attacks in [[southern Lebanon]], as Israel intensifies its assault and issues [[Forced displacement|mass displacement]] orders across the region. The [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli military]] alleges that it is a targeted attack. ***An Israeli military [[Airstrike|air raid]] kills ten people, including four children, in [[northern Gaza]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/5/28/israeli-attack-on-gaza-city-kills-at-least-10-including-four-children (Al Jazeera)]
